difficulty_reason: For W -> X smooth over a thickening X c X': reduces to the affine first-order situation, lifts block by block via the Koszul regular sequence lifting, verifies the smoothness of the assembled W_i' -> X' on the cut pieces, and assembles the etale covering with the cartesian diagrams; the lifting claim is verified in-span.
